description: This file defines the ContentImageGet interface, which extends ImageGet and provides methods for retrieving images and image names related to content management within the sales manager core module.

classes.name: ContentImageGet
classes.description: An interface that extends ImageGet, providing methods to retrieve images and image names by merchant store code and content type.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Retrieves an image as an OutputContentFile object based on merchant store code, image name, and content type.

methods.name: getImageNames
methods.description: Returns a list of image names for a given merchant store code and content type.
